items.title: Bitcoin, XRP, Solana and Tron beat Ethereum and Cardano every month since 2022 on investor buying
items.whyYouShouldCare: The consistent investor preference for Bitcoin, XRP, Solana, and Tron over Ethereum and Cardano indicates a shift in market dynamics that could enhance SOL's competitive positioning.

items.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs break $1B in their best week since April and BlackRock brought in 80% of the cash
items.whyYouShouldCare: The surge in Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs, particularly driven by BlackRock, signals growing institutional interest that may positively impact overall market liquidity, including for Solana.

items.title: Bitcoin whales accumulate for 5 days – Can BTC escape THIS channel?
items.whyYouShouldCare: Increased accumulation by Bitcoin whales suggests potential volatility, which could influence investor sentiment and trading strategies across the crypto ecosystem, including Solana.
